Dormakaba 8900 Series Door Closer, DRM 8916AF89613

The 8900 Series hydraulic backcheck feature protects doors and their adjacent structures. Its valve adjustment regulates backcheck intensity. In addition, a backcheck positioning adjustment for parallel arm applications provides a consistent range similar to regular and top jamb applications. The 8916 AF89 has a fully adjustable spring to meet barrier-free accessibility requirements, and comes with a regular flat form arm.

Features and Specifications for Dormakaba 8913DS Grade 1 Door Closers

  • Adjustable Spring Size 1-6
  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Aluminum Alloy Shell
  • Closer Body Length: 13"
  • Closer Body Height: 3-1/4"
  • Maximum Door Size: 48" interior / 42" exterior
  • Finish: 613 Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Arm: Standard Flat Form
  • Non Handed
  • UL10C & UBC 7.2 1997
  • UL and ULC listed
  • ANSI/BHMA A156.4 Grade 1 Certified
  • Independently certified to 10 million cycles
  • 25 Year Warranty
